description: This PHP source file defines the 'AdministrationViewThemeConfigSettings' class which manages display and processing of theme configuration settings in the SuiteCRM admin interface. It includes methods for rendering the settings form, processing form submissions to update theme configurations, and ensuring administrative access control.

classes.name: AdministrationViewThemeConfigSettings
classes.description: A view class extending SugarView, responsible for handling the display and update of theme configuration settings in SuiteCRM's administration module.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates the parameters for the module's title bar, including a link to the administration index and the theme settings label.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles incoming requests, verifies user permissions, validates theme parameter, processes form submissions to save theme settings, and redirects appropriately.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the theme configuration settings form using the template engine, passing current theme configuration and language strings.
